meta.name: Verdaderamente aterrador
meta.description: Se detallan encuentros paranormales desde el punto de vista de quienes los vivieron a través de recreaciones inmersivas y entrevistas actuales.
meta.country: United States of America, United Kingdom

videos.title: Episodio 1
videos.overview: Geneseo College, 1984. Avid runner Chris Di Cesare is keen to start his freshman year — until strange voices and inexplicable feelings of dread set in.

videos.title: Episodio 2
videos.overview: As Chris becomes increasingly isolated, a friend urges him to try communicating with the entity that haunts him. But his waking nightmares only worsen.

videos.title: Episodio 3
videos.overview: Rumors fly after a friend's harrowing encounter. After making an ominous discovery while running with his dad, Chris decides to face the force alone.

videos.title: This House Murdered Me (1)
videos.overview: Eager to start fresh, a young family moves into a dreamy Victorian-style mansion. But the fixer-upper soon becomes costly and deeply disturbing.

videos.title: This House Murdered Me (2)
videos.overview: From burning sage to hiring paranormal investigators, April and Matt fight for the house. Can they face its horrifying history and win their home back?
